description: Source code for an API parser class that reads markdown documentation files, extracts class/method/parameter info, and constructs a structured API documentation model.

classes.name: ApiParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing markdown API documentation files into structured class, method, and parameter representations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the parser, reads markdown files from a directory, and builds internal class/method structures.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a class definition node from markdown and adds it to the internal class map.

methods.name: parseMember
methods.description: Parses a class member (method, event, property) node and adds it to the corresponding class.

methods.name: parseArgument
methods.description: Parses parameter or option nodes and associates them with class methods.

methods.name: parseProperty
methods.description: Parses property type definitions within parameter nodes.

methods.name: parseType
methods.description: Recursively parses type definitions from markdown list items.

methods.name: parseVariable
methods.description: Extracts variable name, type, and optionality from a line of markdown.
